title: A subsampled hit on the last sample gives a reversed rank range and panics
body:
`Index::rank_range` (`libsufr/src/index.rs`, the `Subsampled` arm) turns a hit on the subsampled suffixes into a range of ranks in the whole suffix array. When the hit is the single last sample, it ends the range at `ranks.len()`, the number of samples, instead of at `len_suffixes`. The range is then reversed or short, and `suffixes_at` panics in `FileAccess::get_range`.

Reproduce with `sufr locate -m 1 data/inputs/1.sufr T`. A sweep at 2632038 and at the step 3 commit found 30 panicking (fixture, flags, query) combinations, the same before and after, so the behavior predates the reorganization. The code carries a TODO at the site.

When a hit spans more than one sample, the range ends at `ranks[last] + 1`, which also cuts off the last group. That may be the same mistake or a second one.
close_reason: Fixed in d7f219c. Two defects: the multi-group end at ranks[last] + 1 (Ken, da1222f) dropped most of the last group, and the last-group end at ranks.len() (refactor, bd21d2e) was the panic. Both end at the next sample's rank or num_suffixes now; count_under_a_cap_matches_count_without_one pins it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text: At cff9fb6 the site is `searched_ranks` (`index.rs:506-521`), with the TODO at :511. `sufr locate -m 1 data/inputs/1.sufr T` panics with "assertion failed: range.start <= range.end" at `io.rs:147`, reached through `suffixes_at` (`index.rs:524`).

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: On dev both defects were fixed in 9984777 (PR #14). `SufrSearch` in `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` gained `num_suffixes`, kept apart from the `len_suffixes` the binary search runs over, and a hit ends at the next sample's rank or at `num_suffixes`. `count_under_a_cap_matches_count_without_one` in `sufr/tests/cli.rs` pins it.
